NeuralPool Node v1.0.0

- Initial release of neuralpool-node, enabling anyone to monetize idle LLM API capacity or access 100+ models via a unified OpenAI-compatible API.
- Includes detailed setup guides for both node operators (supply-side) and API consumers (demand-side).
- Features secure, encrypted gRPC tunnel connection, zero-trust API key handling, customizable pricing, and Solana-based settlements.
- Supports a wide range of upstream providers, real-time token-based billing, and centralized marketplace dashboard.
- Documentation provided in both English and Japanese.
